summary: Implements the three parent-facing mock auth screens and routes exactly per task: root redirects to /login, login → /growth, register → /onboarding, onboarding → /growth. Contract compliance is good: no credential persistence, no network/backend calls, no external assets, and an explicit local-demo disclaimer ("家庭资料仅用于本地课程演示") avoids any production-auth claim. Accessibility is solid (labelled inputs via htmlFor, fieldset/legend for gender radios, aria-label on the password visibility toggle, role="alert" on errors). Tests cover the key flows and the compatibility note preserves the prior moments regression. Only minor nits: raw <a href> navigation instead of router <Link>, hardcoded/stale-able date bounds in onboarding, and chrome-hiding not verifiable from the sanitized bundle. No security or data-impact concerns; no P0.
